messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Energy, Mining, ESG & External Affairs Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mycelium Team,

Your executive-search coverage across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and wider Gulf, including energy and mining, aligns with my international leadership profile. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where growth requires institutional trust, regulatory coordination and responsible development. Saudi Arabia is my first priority market, followed by the UAE, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
